subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become crawl-remote's sole production deployment authority with Vincent Koc as the actor-bound dispatcher, and what independent protected-environment approval policy must apply?
rationale: Repository checks can validate the fail-closed implementation but cannot authorize the durable cross-repository production owner, separation-of-duties policy, Cloudflare token permissions, or live environment configuration.

options.title: Approve with independent environment review
options.body: Keep the named dispatcher while requiring a separate protected-environment approver, verified least-privilege token and fingerprint, coordinated retirement, and a supervised dormant rollout.

options.title: Approve single-operator authority
options.body: Accept the proposed dispatcher and protected-environment configuration without an additional separation-of-duties requirement.

options.title: Keep deployment elsewhere
options.body: Decline the authority transfer and retain production deployment in crawl-remote or move it to a dedicated operations repository.

recommendation.title: Approve with independent environment review
recommendation.body: Keep the named dispatcher while requiring a separate protected-environment approver, verified least-privilege token and fingerprint, coordinated retirement, and a supervised dormant rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history provides the strongest available ownership trail for ClawSweeper workflow architecture and the proposed deployment design, although final approval should include another repository owner for independence.
